name: W047 approved N11 N12 verification and screenshots

on:
  push:
    branches: ['work/n1112-guided-review-20261103']
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/w047-n1112-verification.yml'
      - 'src/data/textbook/math/numbers/n11Authored.json'
      - 'src/data/textbook/math/numbers/n11Transformation.json'
      - 'src/data/textbook/math/numbers/n12Authored.json'
      - 'tools/textbook/transformation/n11-source-binding.mjs'
      - 'tools/textbook/transformation/validate.mjs'
      - 'work/items/W-MATH-047-n1112-guided-review/verify_current.mjs'
      - 'work/items/W-MATH-047-n1112-guided-review/capture_n11.mjs'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: w047-n1112-verification
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      VITE_PREVIEW_COMMIT: ${{ github.sha }}
      VITE_STORAGE_NAMESPACE: kyotsu-step-gate3-math-20261023
      VITE_BASE_PATH: /kyotsu-step-web/
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 11.9.0
          run_install: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - run: python -m pip install -r tools/textbook/research/requirements-solution.txt
      - name: Verify current approved content, grading, saves and exact AST bridge
        run: EVIDENCE_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/w047-evidence/static" node work/items/W-MATH-047-n1112-guided-review/verify_current.mjs
      - name: Mathematical and existing learner behavior regression
        run: |
          node --test tools/textbook/tests/transformation.test.mjs
          pnpm exec vitest run --config work/items/W-MATH-038-transformation-groups/vitest.config.mjs -t 'node and browser|fraction blank|N11 opts in|legacy later answers'
      - name: Build exact checked-out app
        run: pnpm run build
      - run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Both units at four widths, all answers and wrong choices, saved histories
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pnpm exec vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4391 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/w047-preview.log" 2>&1 &
          preview_pid=$!
          trap 'kill "$preview_pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
          node --input-type=module -e 'for(let i=0;i<100;i++){try{if((await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:4391/kyotsu-step-web/")).ok)process.exit(0)}catch{}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100))}process.exit(1)'
          export APP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4391/kyotsu-step-web/
          for code in n11 n12; do
            CODES="$code" WIDTHS=320,390,430,1440 EVIDENCE_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/w047-evidence/$code" node work/items/W-MATH-038-transformation-groups/verify_app.mjs
          done
          EVIDENCE_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/w047-evidence/n11-focus" node work/items/W-MATH-047-n1112-guided-review/capture_n11.mjs
      - name: Retain actual current-source reports and PNGs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: w047-n1112-evidence-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/w047-evidence
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
